head: DT-275

head: DT-385
sites: Npc.js chase pathFailed (npcHate noPath), ATTACK_TIMEOUT_MS; GeodataEngine.hasLineOfSight height ray

head: DT-475
what: No NPC buy list holds a C-grade weapon or armour piece: of 537 item ids the lists can emit, ranks are d 120, none 155, non-gear 262, c/b/a/s 0, while the item data has 407 C items; Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village weapon and armour NPCs (7084, 7088, 7178, 7179, 7684, 7230, 7837, 7838) are bound and spawned but reuse D-or-lower base lists (the file header says the lists were seeded from C2 pages) → a level 40+ character has no NPC source of C gear; with no D crystals on sale the Luxury exchange is unreachable too, so a fresh world wears D to level 52+ (economy model, x10 40 h: 96 C pieces against 9086 D)
fix: add the C4 NPC C-grade rows to the Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village weapon and armour lists from a named C4 source (which pieces each shop sold in C4 is to be verified, not taken from memory); rebuild the bot tables

closed.reason: refuted by the project's data reference: l2hub.info C4 sell lists of the ten weapon and armour traders of Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village top out at D (top items' grade d on their item pages); C gear in C4 comes from the Giran Luxury exchange for crystals, craft and drops. The game's lists follow C4; Goddard, Rune, Heine, Dion not checked
